caption:
A few small habits worth trying this week.

Number 1 comes first for a reason. While you sleep, your brain clears out waste that builds up during the day, which is why a short night shows up as slow, foggy thinking the next morning.

Number 3 has been the hardest swap for me: 10 pages of a book on the train instead of 10 minutes on my phone.

Save this for your next foggy morning, and share it with the group chat.
